author: drewsef20
body: People prefer broken/poor because the negative stats are lower. If you masterforge the item, the bonus goes up to its masterforged level, regardless of the starting quality. In other words, the normal and famed will have the same bonus at level 11. If you masterforge a broken, you’ll pay less in materials and have less negative stats.

author: Widogeist
body:
The various mimic heads give different bonuses. The Ancient Mimic Head gives 20% luck bonus, the Mimic King head gives orn + gold bonus. Between the two I would use the mimic king head for the extra orns and gold, luck bonuses are much easier to come by.

Edit: As a side note, [this spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H1Fa-J8DgF-5rkupEbOW90cREhmr6xukn_jGstjEfmo/edit?gid=1790492424#gid=1790492424) comes in pretty handy to look at and compare the different booster items in the game (exp, gold, orns, luck, etc).
